bootstrap.qualification: oracle initial geometry and multiview appearance bootstrap; no later images used

settings.model: 12-mode linear elastic graph + smooth frame-held ground reaction; exact linear propagator/covariance/constant-load integrals; transferred frozen neural noise
settings.transition_integrals: balanced 5x5 modal-pair and 3x3 affine matrix exponentials; no fixed covariance/load quadrature
settings.noise_units: floor .15 and balanced edge scale .20 in acceleration diffusion; transfer assumptions, not PAC-calibrated
settings.force_comparison: same Gaussian unknown-load prior; analytic marginalization versus explicit joint variables
settings.proposal: exact causal innovation coordinates; fixed full observed RGB Gauss-Newton Gaussian reference; split HMC with exact MH target

map_scores.qualification: 128 fixed frame-zero-selected particle correspondences; conditional on supplied initial geometry; deterministic dataset, no force ground-truth claim
map_scores.region_metric_definition: evaluation-only abs(target-empty_background).max(channel) > .10; includes shadows; not a true object mask

map_score_definition: image scores at stationary innovation-density reference, not a physical-density MAP

posterior_scores.qualification: 128 fixed frame-zero-selected particle correspondences; conditional on supplied initial geometry; deterministic dataset, no force ground-truth claim
posterior_scores.region_metric_definition: evaluation-only abs(target-empty_background).max(channel) > .10; includes shadows; not a true object mask

convergence.criteria: rank/folded split Rhat <1.01, bulk and tail ESS >=400, no frozen chains
convergence.limitation: Passing finite-chain diagnostics cannot exclude unvisited modes or establish model calibration.
